title: Quick call with Ada, freelance illustrator
fictional: Every person, company and amount in this call is made up. Voices are macOS text-to-speech.

lines.speaker: others
lines.name: Ada (illustrator)
lines.text: Hi, it's Ada. The bike icon for the booking page is finished.

lines.speaker: you
lines.name: You
lines.text: I saw it this morning. It's exactly what we wanted.

lines.speaker: others
lines.name: Ada (illustrator)
lines.text: Great. For the icon itself, my fee is one dollar.

lines.speaker: you
lines.name: You
lines.text: Fair enough. I'll pay the illustrator one dollar today for the icon.

lines.speaker: others
lines.name: Ada (illustrator)
lines.text: Thanks. I can also send the source files, so you can change the colours later.

lines.speaker: you
lines.name: You
lines.text: Yes please. I'll pay the illustrator another fifty cents once you send the source files.

lines.speaker: others
lines.name: Ada (illustrator)
lines.text: Deal. You'll have them by Friday.
